rules.guidance: Use try-with-resources for `AutoCloseable` (streams, connections) so they close on every path.
Guard against NPE: prefer `Optional`/null checks; don't return null collections (return empty).
Don't catch `Exception`/`Throwable` broadly and swallow; catch specific types or rethrow with context.
Use `StringBuilder` for string building in loops, not `+`.
Use `PreparedStatement` with bind params; never concatenate untrusted input into SQL.
Don't expose internal mutable collections/arrays directly; return copies or unmodifiable views.
